title: TAMAMO-NO-MAE
subtitle: the fox who fooled an emperor
source: Otogi-zoshi 'Tamamo-no-mae'; Noh play 'Sessho-seki'; Sessho-seki, Nasu, Tochigi (split March 2022)

yasunari.name: Bill Adams - Wise and Motivational American Storyteller

lines.say: [nervous] Kon... why is that rock smoking?
[sly] Because it's not a rock. It's a prison.
[shocked] A PRISON?!
[storytelling] Nine hundred years ago, the most beautiful woman in Japan appeared at the emperor's palace. Her name was Tamamo-no-Mae.
cap: the most beautiful woman in Japan

lines.say: She knew every poem, every answer, every secret. Some say her body glowed in the dark.
[suspicious] Okay, that's not normal.
[ominous] The emperor fell in love. Then he fell sick. Every night, a little weaker. No doctor could explain it.
So the court called its greatest diviner. Abe no Yasunari.
cap: So the court called its greatest diviner.

lines.say: [cold] Your Majesty... that woman is not human.
[intense] He held a sacred mirror up to her. And in the reflection... nine tails.
cap: He held a {o:sacred mirror} up to her.

lines.say: [screaming] NINE TAILS?!
[menacing laugh] I have ruined greater kings than yours.
Legends say she had already brought down kingdoms in India and China. Japan was supposed to be next.
[excited] She fled to the plains of Nasu. The emperor sent eighty thousand warriors after her.
cap: She fled to the plains of {g:Nasu}.

lines.say: For days she outran them all. Until an archer's arrow finally struck her down.
cap: For days she outran them all.

lines.say: [relieved] So she's dead!
[darkly] Her body turned to stone. And anything that touched that stone... died. Birds. Animals. People.
cap: And anything that touched that stone...

lines.say: They called it Sessho-seki. The Killing Stone.
[whispering] For centuries it sat on that mountain, tied with sacred rope. Until March, twenty twenty-two... when it split in half.
cap: For centuries it sat on that mountain,

lines.say: [panicking] Wait, THAT rock?! It's OPEN?!
[casually] Relax. Experts said it was just the weather.
cap: Experts said it was just the {g:weather}.

lines.say: [nervous] ...And what do YOU say?
[sly] [amused] I say... it feels good to stretch my tails.
cap: it feels good to {r:stretch my tails}.

lines.say: [terrified] ...KON?!
